why: State cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/state-1.md, P2 state-1.8): `docs/connection-indicator.md` places `ConnectionIndicator` 'in the end slot of the page bar', and `PageBarProps` (title, parent, controls, tabs, refresh, actions) has no slot for it. The build put it on the filter row (`OrdersPage.tsx:299`), and the shipped page doctrine gives no other home.
what: The page bar takes the connection.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/page/connection-indicator.tsx (only if its placement needs a variant)
their tests and a layout test
change: `PageBar` takes `connection?: ConnectionView` and draws `ConnectionIndicator` in its end slot, before `refresh`, at every width (the indicator already folds its word below 840 px). Without the prop nothing changes. A layout test draws a bar with `connection`, `refresh` and two actions at 1800 and 390 px and asserts the indicator sits before the refresh button on one line.
acceptance: `<PageBar connection={view} refresh={…} />` draws the indicator before the refresh button at 1800 and 390 px (layout test)
out_of_scope: What the indicator shows; the `tabs` prop (v3-state-1-api).
